urls.title: Website URLs
urls.description: Direct list of business websites to scan. When provided, discovery is skipped. Best for demos and known lists.

category.title: Category
category.description: Business category for discovery (e.g. plumber, salon, roofer). Used when 'urls' is empty.

location.title: Location
location.description: City / area for discovery (e.g. 'Austin, TX'). Used when 'urls' is empty.

maxResults.title: Max businesses
maxResults.description: Maximum number of businesses to scan.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus up to this many internal pages (contact/about/services) per site.

minScore.title: Minimum lead score
minScore.description: Only push leads scoring at or above this (0-100).

includeNoWebsite.title: Include businesses with no website
includeNoWebsite.description: Include discovered businesses that have no website (evaluated for New Website Build opportunities). If disabled, only businesses with websites will be crawled and audited.
